title: When You Break One

launchpad.outcome: Break a rule (it happens), skip the shame spiral, and turn it into an IF / THEN response.
launchpad.missionQuestion: What will I do when this trigger shows up again?

slides.headline: You broke one of your rules. What happens now?
slides.line: You missed a winner, so you chased the next trade, and it lost. Let’s look at what to do next.

slides.headline: Investigate what happened, and don’t punish yourself.

cards.label: Shame spiral
cards.sub: You ask yourself, “What is wrong with me?”

cards.label: Detective mode
cards.sub: You find the trigger and plan for next time.

check.prompt: What would you do now that you’ve broken a rule?

options.label: Stop trading for a whole week
options.feedback: It feels responsible, but it teaches you nothing about what to do next Tuesday at 10:04.

options.label: Ignore it, because it’s a new day
options.feedback: Then the trigger stays right where it is, waiting for you next time.

options.label: Investigate it like a detective
options.feedback: Yes. A broken rule is a clue to study, not a verdict on you.

slides.headline: Answer four questions, and then make a plan.
slides.line: Tap each question to see what you’re looking for.

steps.label: Which rule?
steps.sub: Name the exact rule that you broke.

steps.label: What came before?
steps.sub: Find the trigger that happened right before you broke it.

steps.label: What did you want?
steps.sub: Ask whether you wanted to get something or avoid something.

steps.label: Next time?
steps.sub: Write “If this trigger happens, then I will do this.”

slides.title: You chased.
scenario: You missed the previous winner (no retest).

options: No market entry after a missed retest
action.correct: No market entry after a missed retest

slides.thenPrefill: screenshot it, mark it MISSED ACCORDING TO PLAN, and wait for a new valid setup
slides.punch: Saved. The next time a missed winner shows up, your answer is already written.

slides.fallbackLine: A missed winner often creates an urge to chase the next one.
slides.punch: This is what the Academy shows you whenever this trigger comes back.

slides.quote: A broken rule is data about a trigger. Turn it into a plan, not a punishment.

slides.prompt: What will you do the next time your trigger shows up?
slides.modelAnswer: I review it: which rule, what happened right before, what I wanted, and IF this trigger happens again THEN what I’ll do. No shame, just a plan.

remember: JOURNAL WHAT YOU’LL DO WHEN THE TRIGGER RETURNS.
